A '''trading village''' was a collection of habitations in the [[Unidentified Naboo swamp|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] near the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">The video game itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[Skirmishes in the Naboo countryside|entered]] the swamps and demanded the village's surrender. The villagers refused, and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces opened fire. Following their leader, [[Rohan Wayside]], the villagers took their [[Naboo houseboat|houseboats]] and fled deeper into the swamps. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Security Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] were searching for the village to recruit [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. The officers engaged the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Federation]] [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboats]] and rescued the villagers. In gratitude, Wayside sent his best pilot, [[Vedd Deviss]], to lead the officers on a [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|mission]] to find a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who could help fight the Federation [[Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The village appears in a mission from the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. It is also featured in the third bonus mission, a non-[[canon]] scenario wherein the player takes the role of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] in his personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']], to lead a Trade Federation attack force and destroy every Naboo civilian and military target&mdash;people, land vehicles, and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]&mdash;in the level.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
